title: Near-Earth Asteroid 2018 RC very close encounter: online observations – 8 Sept. 2018

body:
Next 9 Sept. 2018, the near-Earth Asteroid 2018 RC will have a very close, but safe, encounter with us, coming at about 220.000 km from the Earth’s surface, 50% of the lunar distance. The Virtual Telescope Project will show it to you live.

https://www.virtualtelescope.eu/webtv/
